summary: Full backend + frontend test of the new booking engine, availability/iCal fields, admin bookings & reviews, lightbox and Airbnb CTAs. Backend: 46/46 pytest tests pass (20 new in test_bookings_reviews.py + 26 regression in backend_test.py). Frontend: every requested flow verified end-to-end on the public preview URL — booking widget calendar with blocked dates, price math (650.000 x 3 + 80.000 = 2.030.000), request-to-book submit -> success panel, admin approve/reject with badge update, reviews CRUD reflected on the public property page, new property fields incl. ical_url persistence, price on property card, ES i18n strings, lightbox zoom/nav/counter, and regressions (ImageManager, inquiries tab, footer Admin link, home page). Only cosmetic issues found; no functional defects.

minor.issue: iCal cache (_ical_cache) is keyed by slug only and holds for 30 min, so changing/removing ical_url in admin keeps serving stale blocked ranges until TTL expiry (and cache is per-worker). Key it by (slug, url) and invalidate on property update.

No rate limiting / anti-abuse: each request triggers a real owner email; a bot can spam. Also no unique/atomic guard, so two concurrent identical requests can both pass the overlap check (TOCTOU double-book).

Playbook deviation: no brute-force lockout (unlimited wrong-password attempts return 401) and token is returned in JSON for localStorage instead of an httpOnly cookie. CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True. bcrypt hash format verified OK ($2b$12$); seed_admin correctly re-hashes when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
No pagination/limit cap (hard-coded to_list(100)); rating is not range-validated in ReviewInput (a 99 would be accepted; UI clamps stars to 5).

ui_bugs.issue: In Spanish at 1920px the 'CONTACTO' link right edge (x=971) collides with the centered 'STAY CORAL' logo (x=971) and renders as 'CONTACTOSTAY CORAL'. Longer ES labels overflow the nav slot.
Gallery thumbnail buttons that open the lightbox have no data-testid (had to select via 'property-detail img'). Add gallery-image-{i}.
COP is rendered as '$ 650.000' with no currency marker, so COP vs USD is indistinguishable (spec asked for 'COP $X / night'). Use currencyDisplay:'code' or append the currency code.

issues: Console React warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from ReviewsTab.jsx line 55 option label ({n} ★) wrapped by the dev instrumentation — dev-only noise, but rendering the option label as a plain string (e.g. `${n} ★`) removes it.

action_items: Fix ES header overlap between 'Contacto' nav link and centered logo at >=1280px widths
Key the iCal cache by url (not slug) and bust it when a property's ical_url changes
Add basic rate limiting / honeypot to POST /api/bookings (real emails fire per request)
Optional: show currency code (COP/USD) alongside formatted prices
Optional: add data-testid to gallery thumbnails; add login lockout + httpOnly cookie if the auth playbook is required
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _ical_cache keyed on slug with 30-min TTL causes stale availability after ical_url edits; also module-global so it is not shared/invalidated across workers.
server.py create_booking: overlap check and insert are not atomic — add a unique/compound guard or transaction to prevent concurrent double bookings.
server.py: no throttle on the public booking/inquiry endpoints that trigger outbound email.
ReviewInput.rating has no ge/le bounds; frontend clamps display only.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (fixed test bug: relative /api/images URL now prefixed with BASE_URL)
